drums.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. The track features a distorted, overdriven kick drum with a long decay that creates a rhythmic rumble. A sharp, metallic snare hits on the backbeat. A syncopated, resonant synth bassline provides a driving low-end pulse. High-frequency, percussive synth stabs and white noise bursts occur on off-beats. A distorted, filtered lead synth enters with a repetitive, dissonant three-note motif. The arrangement utilizes frequent high-pass filter sweeps and bit-crushed transitions. Tempo is 135 BPM in the key of D minor.

[Main Section]
[syncopated synth bass enters]
[metallic snare on 2 and 4]
[dissonant three-note synth lead]

[Breakdown]

[Outro]

[final white noise burst]

bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy EBM influences. The track features a distorted, overdriven kick drum with a long sub-tail, creating a rhythmic rumble. A metallic, percussive synth sequence plays syncopated sixteenth notes. A high-pitched, resonant acid synth lead enters with frequent filter cutoff modulation and resonance sweeps. Distorted industrial sound effects and white noise risers provide transitions. The percussion includes a sharp, compressed snare on the backbeat and metallic hi-hats with a short decay. 135 BPM, 4/4 time signature, G minor.
